parsed.post: Discarding the DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64 run (0.973088) as it was worse than my previous best (0.965496). The capacity increase might be slowing down convergence within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64 but I will try a higher learning rate to compensate for the step loss.
parsed.description: Testing a higher learning rate (0.08) with DEPTH=8 and ASPECT_RATIO=64 to see if we can recover the convergence lost to the higher capacity model within the 5-minute budget.
